reader.requirement: At --std 85 the first KEY IS data-name-2 (qualified or not, in either OCCURS format) must resolve, under the 1985 qualification rule (a non-unique name must be qualified to uniqueness, with no implicit qualification by the subject's groups), to the entry containing the OCCURS clause or one subordinate to it, and every subsequent data-name-2 to an entry strictly subordinate to it; anything else is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ClauseOperandsTakeImplicitQualifiers (Edition.DialectLevel >= 2002): from 2002 the table subtree is the candidate set; at 85 the whole scope's candidates narrowed by the written qualifiers, counted for ambiguity, then OccursKeyResolvePass.Run asks IsWithinRegion of the survivor
dialectLevel < 2002 SR12 walk (reached only after SR3 has placed the key)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: an unqualified key name that is also declared outside the table is ambiguous (COBOL1639) at 85, where §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 requires qualification, and resolves to the table's own item at 2023 by implicit qualification
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1018_occurs_key_qualified covers a qualified key; the outside-the-table refusal, the subsequent-key-names-the-subject refusal, a qualifier pointing outside the table and the 85 ambiguity arm are exercised only by the probes

COBOL2353 for KEY IS K OF OTHER-REC and KEY IS K2 OF E1 (qualifier selecting an item outside the table)
probes.expected: refused: the named item is not the subject or subordinate to it

probes.printed: 85: COBOL1639 'K' does not uniquely identify a data item (K also in OTHER-REC); 2023: compiles and runs, AT 3
probes.expected: 85: qualification required for a non-unique name (§1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SR3)

AT 4 / E2 OK / E3 OK (first key = subject; DESCENDING K2 OF E2 then ASCENDING K3 subordinate; key = subject of an OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON table)

reader.notes: The placement test (IsWithinRegion plus the subsequent-key-is-the-subject check) is shared by every edition; what 85 changes is the candidate set, and the 85 arm correctly demands qualification of a name declared elsewhere (PB5165 landed this arm). The diagnostic text cites §2023:13.18.38.3 SR3, whose words match the 1985 rule.
